text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. One of its main tasks is image recognition, where a system identifies what is in a picture, such as a cat, a tree, or a face. A related skill is object detection, which goes further by locating objects and drawing boxes around them. These technologies have many practical applications. For example, in self-driving cars, computer vision helps the vehicle recognize traffic lights, pedestrians, and other cars to drive safely. It is also used in medical imaging, security cameras, and even smartphone photo apps. As this technology improves, it is becoming a part of everyday life, making machines smarter and more helpful.
